description: A 38kHz infrared remote control with 20 function keys, used purely as a simulator UI control — it sends IR commands to an IR receiver wirelessly within the simulation.
how_to_use: No documented pinout was found (docs.wokwi.com's own reference page for it lists only its function keys, not pins) — this part appears to have no diagram-wireable legs at all, since it isn't physically connected to anything (a real IR remote isn't wired into a circuit either). Do not assume any pin names for it without confirming first.
